prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Learn simple shortcuts and gestures to command, chat with, or hide your companion anytime.", "Right-click your pet to open quick actions. Press Ctrl+Shift+P to hide or summon them.", "Got It!"]
1: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Select whether you want to adopt an instant starter pet or create a unique custom companion from your photos.", "Starter Pet vs Custom Creation"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet for the Desktop", "We are calibrating window transparency, placement, and animations so your pet arrives smoothly.", "Initializing companion desktop engine..."]
3: ["Photo Upload Best Practices", "For best custom pet results, use clear, well-lit photos with distinct subject edges.", "Ensure clear lighting, front-facing subject, and high resolution.", "Continue to Upload"]
4: ["Please sign in with your original account to access existing pets and progress.", "Note: Using a different login will create a new profile and won't carry over current pets."]
5: ["Generating official adoption records and assembling pet assets...", "Finalizing adoption papers..."]
6: ["Your pet is rendering in the background. You will receive a notification as soon as it lands on your screen!"]
7: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Adventure", "In just 2 minutes, pick a ready-to-play pet or turn your favorite photos into a unique virtual friend.", "Start Setup"]
8: ["Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Check your system tray near the clock anytime to hide, summon, or customize your companion.", "Pro Tip: Look for the pet icon in your system tray"]
9: ["Select Your Starter Pet", "Choose your favourite virtual companion to start playing right away."]
